text:
tom_hart: Hey team — kicking off a short sync on the Smart Routing / Fallback PRD. Need to lock scope for the next sprint: customer-driven asks (region isolation for finserv, predictable p50 <= 120ms), acceptance criteria, and edge-case list. Can folks add must-haves vs nice-to-haves?

alex_lee: +1 — can we get a single-page acceptance criteria list? I suggest: 1) deterministic fallback ordering, 2) ~99% success of automatic fallback when primary model unavailable, 3) no silent quality regressions for top 25 prompts.

maria_g: From SRE side: also need rollout gating metrics and rollback triggers. Minimal set: p99 latency, p50 latency, error-rate, fallback-success-rate, and region-failover-time. Rollback if p99 spikes > 2x baseline for 5m.

kevin_w: For scope, propose we ship core features: tier mapping (prod/stable/cost), region compatibility matrix, and model-variant mapping. Leave advanced heuristics (ML-based selection) as follow-up.

saira_k: On model quality: we must define an automated smoke eval tied to each fallback candidate. Suggested bar: top-25 prompt embeddings cosine >= 0.92 vs primary, or human review flag. Also capture prompt-specific regressions (store sample prompts per customer).

tom_hart: Good. For customer asks: bank A needs region-locking (EU-only) and guaranteed fallback to a certified on-prem variant. Bank B wants low-cost fallbacks that prioritize cost over latency. We need policy knobs for per-customer routing.

alex_lee: Implementation note: routing policy should be policy-driven JSON, e.g.:
```json
{"tier": "prod", "region_order": ["eu-west-1", "eu-central-1"], "fallback_order": ["gptx-13b-std", "gptx-13b-q4", "gptx-13b-4bit"], "max_additional_latency_ms": 200}
```
Keep schema simple and versioned.

maria_g: Edge case: partial KV cache incompatibility between quantized variants -> could cause latency spikes on cold starts. Need acceptance test that warms cache, and metric that alerts if cold-start latency > threshold after failover.

kevin_w: Another edge: model variant compatibility (different context window). If fallback has smaller ctx, we need truncation policy and user-visible warning. Add to acceptance criteria: fallback must preserve semantics or explicitly degrade with a clear error.

saira_k: Also: incompatible tokenization between models. Add automated tokenizer-check during model onboarding; if mismatch, block auto-fallback for that pairing until we add a tokenizer shim.

tom_hart: Launch criteria checklist draft:
- PRD approved by Eng, SRE, and ML (owners listed)
- Compatibility matrix populated for top 10 models
- Smoke eval pass for fallback candidates
- Rollout plan with canary (5% traffic) and automated rollback
- Customer opt-in controls implemented

ops-bot: Checklist created: smart-routing-prd/2009876543 -> status: open. Assigned: kevin_w.

alex_lee: Acceptance criteria (concise):
- Fallback success >= 98% on simulated outages
- p50 <= 120ms for tier=prod in primary region during normal load
- p99 increase <= 1.5x during canary (5% traffic)
- No undetected quality regressions for defined prompt set

maria_g: We should add SLO burn budget for failovers: if > 10% of budget used in 24h, pause rollouts.

kevin_w: I'll draft the PRD section for routing policy schema, rollout plan, and acceptance tests today. Can we aim to review tomorrow 10:30am PT?

tom_hart: Yes. Add any sticky open questions here: 1) default fallback ordering for cost vs latency customers? 2) how to represent on-prem certified variants in the registry? 3) telemetry labels for per-customer routing decisions?

saira_k: For (1) suggest policy key: "preference": "latency|cost|quality". For (2) registry tag: "cert:customername" and signed artifact. For (3) include labels: route.reason, route.tier, route.fallback_candidate.

alex_lee: Thanks — I'll include those in the draft.

tom_hart: Great work. After kevin posts the PRD draft, please mark items as resolved in this thread.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: PRD-review meeting tomorrow 10:30am PT -> invite sent to participants.
